recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: 125-billion-parameter models running on a single graphics card at a hundred tokens per second
every frame of every video on your machine becoming searchable
autumn fog settling over san francisco bay
overcast october afternoon, wind barely moving
quiet week in the repos — tinkering paused, imagination still running

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Catch falling code fragments in grey autumn fog — tap to spawn micro-agents that scoop shards before they dissolve; each round is one tiny ship milestone.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: 30 seconds to clear one deploy batch and watch the ship meter fill
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: fragments fall faster, agents compete for the same pickups, fog thickens and shrinks the catch zone
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: neon wireframe agents drifting through muted overcast haze

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Scrub a looping video timeline with one continuous thumb drag — find the single hidden frame before the clip resets, like AI search compressed into a one-screen hunt.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: each round unlocks one searchable moment with a satisfying frame-lock snap
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: shorter loops, near-duplicate decoy frames, timeline jitter mid-scrub
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: macOS finder thumbnails with thermal-camera highlight on the target frame

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Hold to charge a deploy pulse, release exactly as the golden-hour line crosses your ship silhouette on an autumn bay horizon — mistimed releases drift into the fog.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: perfect releases stack a shipping streak; one minute to hit five sunrise windows
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: horizon sweeps faster, wind gusts shift the release window, overlapping ships demand split-second choice
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: watercolor sunrise over paper-cutout san francisco skyline

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick parameter blocks (125B, 70B, 7B) into GPU slots on a overheating board — wrong sizes bounce off, right fits trigger a benchmark flash.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: one round = one satisfying 100-tokens-per-second benchmark burst when all slots align
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: chip runs hotter, slots narrow, rogue blocks spawn mid-flick
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: retro PCB green with heat-shimmer and token counter LED readout
